name: Coffee Monopoly
description: One bean, one cup, one vertically integrated empire. Stand up plantations and roasters, put coffee on shelves in two cities, and export enough roasted coffee to fund the next wave. A rival chain starts one step ahead — close the gap before the end of 2029.

goals.description: Operate at least 2 plantations — the bean supply is the foundation of the chain.
Operate at least 2 factories — roast and bottle in-house instead of paying world-market prices.
Put coffee drinks on a shelf — the chain is not real until it reaches a customer.
Sell 35% of the coffee drinks bought in Metropolis (trailing three months).
Sell 30% of the coffee drinks bought in Eastside — proof the chain scales.
Earn $100M of export revenue in total — roughly two roasting lines selling to the world market for most of the scenario. Export prices fall as you flood the world market, so watch the margin.
Earn $30M of net income in total since the start — after depreciation, interest and tax.
